Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: Open Government Partnership (OGP) member with national action plans. Annual reports published by SITA, SASSA, DHA, SARS, and Information Regulator. MyMzansi.gov.za provides public roadmap transparency for the Digital Transformation initiatives. No single public operational dashboard for government data exchange performance metrics. Transparency is moderate via annual reports and public strategy documents.

revised_comments: South Africa publishes annual reports covering elements of its government data exchange ecosystem, including SARS, the Department of Home Affairs and the State Information Technology Agency (SITA), alongside the publicly available Roadmap for the Digital Transformation of Government and the MyMzansi.gov.za portal. The National Treasury-led MzansiXchange data exchange, piloted from October 2025, has published its governance framework and objectives through ministerial speeches and government communications, and envisages future public access to aggregated datasets and dashboards as one of its four planned components. No live public operational dashboard for data exchange performance yet exists, so transparency is delivered through annual reports and published strategy documents rather than real-time public disclosure.
